entries.en: *cough* *wheeze*

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Phew...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: My form's... comin' back...[n]but I don't got... any stamina...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *cough*

entries.speaker: Gym-Going Student
entries.en: Sakamoto?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ikeda-senpai! What's bonkin'?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: "Bonkin'"? You say the strangest things.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Is that how you greet a friend?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've been tryin' to come up with some[n]cool new slang. Maybe it'll catch on!

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: You can't just do that.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Oh, and you don't need to call me[n]senpai anymore. I've already graduated,[n]remember?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Hm? I haven't seen you before...[n]Were you on the track team?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Him? He's, uh... a friend!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the time he showed up, the track[n]team was already... well, y'know.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Speaking of which, how's your leg?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, I'm managin'...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How 'bout you, Senpai? You still runnin'?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I actually joined my university's track[n]team. You'd think I would've quit entirely[n]after what happened...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: About that, I'm real sorry...

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: No, I should be the one apologizing.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I was supposed to be the leader of our[n]team, yet I just resigned myself to[n]Kamoshida's will...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's 'cause you needed him to write[n]your letter of rec, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You were just lookin' out for your future...[n]but I still managed to eff it up anyways.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Kamoshida clearly never intended on[n]writing my letter of recommendation.[n]You were just his excuse not to.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: And honestly, I enjoy where I am now.[n]The track team isn't anything special,[n]but it's perfect for me.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: So in truth, I should be thanking[n]you for what you did, Sakamoto.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Senpai...

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I've always regretted not doing more[n]to protect you guys...

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: But I heard some good news recently...[n]The Shujin track team's being reinstated!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I mean, Kamoshida confessed all[n]the horrible stuff he did, right?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I guess the school got the old team[n]together and told them they want to[n]try starting it up again.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Nobody told me about that.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Huh, odd... The rumors got as far as me,[n]and I'm not even a student anymore.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Anyway, I heard they're going to get[n]Mr. Yamauchi as their new advisor.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yamauchi...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hold up, THAT Yamauchi!?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Yup, the one who was basically[n]Kamoshida's lapdog.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Apparently he volunteered. He's really[n]enthusiastic about pulling the track team[n]up from the ashes.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He is?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: You know, now that the team is being[n]reinstated, there's no need for any bad[n]blood, right?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Why don't you go talk to them?[n]I'm sure they could use someone[n]with your passion.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So the track team's comin' back...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Good for them.
You seem conflicted.[clr 27]
Do you want to rejoin?[clr 27]
You're done with them, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nah, not really...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I dunno.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real though, I'm glad the team's[n]comin' back. It's sweet that Nakaoka[n]and them can start trainin' again.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But I'm still worried 'bout their advisor,[n]Yamauchi. He's basically like a[n]mini-Kamoshida.
So he's short?
So he's an asshole?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That ain't what I meant! He's like[n]Kamoshida, but even MORE of a loser!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He'd always yell at us at practice, but[n]then be a huge kiss-ass when our parents[n]were around.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, I can't believe a moron like that's[n]gonna be advisin' the track team.[n]He doesn't even teach PE!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Basically.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...He's gotta be up to something.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'll do some research...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's a chance I'm gonna need[n]your help too, mkay?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You'd be free to lend me a hand if[n]I need it, yeah? I'll be countin' on you!
I feel like my bond with Ryuji[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, we don't got time to be[n]messin' around here anymore!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's head home!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, I gotta shower first!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seeya!
